mapper.insert: insert into order_outbox_event (event_type, biz_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time) values (#{eventType}, #{bizKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime})
mapper.select: select event_id, event_type, biz_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, update_time from order_outbox_event where (status = 0 and next_retry_time <= now()) or (status = 1 and update_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) order by event_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update order_outbox_event set status = 1, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and (status = 0 or (status = 1 and update_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)))
update order_outbox_event set status = 2, last_error = null, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 1
update order_outbox_event set status = 0, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 1
